warum_diese_datei: Die Gruppierung eines Release kommt aus einer VERSIONIERTEN Inhaltsquelle, nicht aus dem Titelpraefix eines Pull Requests. 6.3.0 ist ein Feature-Release: oben ein Satz, die Installation, vier Highlights, wie man das Release selbst prueft und was ein Beleg nicht beweist; darunter jede Zeile des CHANGELOG-Abschnitts 6.3.0 unter ihrer Ueberschrift, byte-gleich (Owner-Entscheid 12.10.2026, Karte zur Form der Notes, Option A). Kopfsatz und Highlights stehen im Review der Texte 6.3.0.
kopfsatz: **A feature release following 6.2.1.** The installed package adds opt-in eval-result v0.2 export and verification, changes the default DSSE key ID handling, and fixes two pytest receipt behaviours. The repository also adds SCITT statement identification material, a pilot profile and contract, and an incremental Merkle accumulator.

highlights.kern: DSSE key IDs are included by default when available.
highlights.text: Envelopes created by `dsse.sign_envelope`, including in-toto exports, carry the signer's OpenSSH SHA256 fingerprint as an unsigned `keyid` by default when the signer exposes its Ed25519 public key. Use `keyid=""` to omit it; signers without an exposed Ed25519 public key omit it unless supplied explicitly.

highlights.kern: eval-result v0.2 for the revised in-toto draft.
highlights.text: An opt-in export and verification under its own predicate type; exports still default to v0.1, and `--verify` accepts both.
The repository includes requirements and a verification package in `docs/scitt/statement_identification/`.

highlights.kern: Repository pilot material and an incremental accumulator.
highlights.text: A profile and vectors for the shipped decision and outcome predicates, the first pilot contract, and an incremental Merkle accumulator with a restart rule are provided under `docs/` and `tools/`.

selbst_pruefen: Use the checksums and build provenance to check the downloaded files. To check the signed pre-tag audit receipt, use a clone at the source commit identified by the build attestation. The commands, prerequisites and limits are in [Verifying a published release](RELEASE.md#verifying-a-published-release-anyone).
nicht_bewiesen: A valid signature binds the signed content to the signing key. It does not make a reported result true.
referenzmessung: The budget cost axis was measured on the reference machine on 2026-10-13. All 12 axes and all 7 combinations passed, and none was skipped. The calibration factor `maschinenfaktor_schnellstes_ende` is 1.0581, the ratio of the fastest recorded calibration time in this run to the median of the earlier reference recording. The timing limits used the fastest-sample setting, recorded as `latte_aus_der_klammer=schnellstes_ende`. The [measurement record](audit_artifacts/360/budget_axis_latest.json) lists every axis and combination.

zeilen: Add opt-in eval-result v0.2 export and verification under `https://b7n0de.com/attestation/eval-result/v0.2` for the revised in-toto draft. Export with `proofbundle intoto --predicate-version v0.2 --evaluator <URI>`. v0.2 requires an `evaluator`, identifies each model and dataset by exactly one of a salted commitment or a digest-bearing ResourceDescriptor, and records artifact digests in `evidence[]`. Receipt evidence uses the SHA-256 of the receipt file's exact bytes. Exports still default to v0.1; `--verify` accepts both versions. See `docs/IN_TOTO_PROFILE.md` for mappings and migration details.

**An independent reading of draft-abak-agent-control-delivery-evidence-01.** Adds `interop/acde_01`, a verifier-side implementation derived from our reading of the text of -01 alone, with 130 requirement sentences, 146 vectors and a run record with agreement 108, contradiction 0, ambiguity 14 and not implemented 8. Nothing outside `interop/acde_01` changes.
Add SCITT statement identification requirements and a package verifiable against them.
Add a pilot profile and vectors for the shipped decision and outcome predicates.
Document which capabilities ship in 6.1.0 and which are available only on the main branch at the documented comparison point.
Add an incremental Merkle accumulator alongside the bundle emitter, with a restart rule and before-and-after run records.
Add the first pilot contract for comparing approved agent actions with GitHub evidence.

DSSE envelopes created by `dsse.sign_envelope`, including in-toto exports, now include the signer's OpenSSH SHA256 fingerprint as `keyid` by default. Use `keyid=""` to omit it; signers without an exposed Ed25519 public key omit it unless supplied explicitly. The key ID is unsigned. The pinned-key DSSE and in-toto verifiers, including `pb_verify_rs verify-dsse`, do not use it to select a key; the trust pack retains its key-selection rules. Archived receipts and regression fixtures may still omit it and be rejected by consumers that require it. See `docs/IN_TOTO_PROFILE.md` for interoperability notes.

Pull-request label changes no longer restart the main CI workflow. The `landung` label starts mutation checks in a separate workflow; new commits rerun them while the label is present, and removing the label cancels them.

The pytest plugin now skips receipt generation and reports why when `PROOFBUNDLE_METRIC` is set to a value other than `pass_rate`, preventing pass-rate values from being labelled as another metric. Unset or `pass_rate` continues to select the pass-rate metric.

The pytest plugin now decides `passed` from the exact counts of passed and run tests instead of from the pass rate rounded to six decimal places. With the `>=` comparator, two passes out of three no longer pass a threshold of `0.666667`.
